GAMES_EOE_BODY1: Echoes of Elysium was the last professional game I worked on with Loric Games for 3 years from January 2023 until February 2026. Echoes of Elysium is a sandbox survival-crafting multiplayer game that takes you to the skies in search for the answers from the past. Along the journey the player builds their homebase on their airship while fighting mythical clockwork beasts.
GAMES_EOE_BODY2: The game is multiplayer with up to 10 players at a time. Players can host their own local games or play together via dedicated servers. Working together is essential for success and large ships.
